data.one_liner: Encode raw RGB images and PCM audio directly to MP4 using hardware h264 encoders.
data.what_it_does: Encodes raw RGB pixel buffers and PCM audio frames into an MP4 video file using native hardware encoders (AVFoundation on iOS and MediaCodec on Android) without requiring FFmpeg.
use_when: You need to generate video files programmatically from raw RGBA frames or widgets.
You want hardware-accelerated video encoding without bundled native libraries like FFmpeg.
avoid_when: You need to playback existing video files or stream video over a network.
You are editing, trimming, or compressing pre-existing video container files rather than rendering from raw frames.
strengths: Zero external dependencies besides Flutter and system libraries.
Uses native hardware encoders for fast performance.
Supports audio encoding (PCM to m4a/audio tracks).
weaknesses: Requires feeding raw frame buffers manually in a loop rather than processing existing video files.
Limited platform support (Android, iOS, macOS only).
data.setup_notes: Enable the platform configurations for Android, iOS, or macOS as required by your app.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick video_player if you need to play videos instead of encoding raw pixel data into a new video.
